title: Owner decides the source and scope
goal: The owner picks how builds come in and what questions are in scope
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Owner decision 2026-11-15: a saved local build note per drone (parts and chosen UARTs) plus cited manufacturer pinouts are the source of truth; a diyfpv.com PNG export is a visual check that refuses when labels are unreadable; reading the diyfpv.com build link directly is also wanted, through the F-089 browser adapter (F-099-T04). No actual: owner time not measured.
